# Forever Item Finder

Finds new and changed items in World of Warcraft: Forever, shares them with other players, and keeps a searchable
database of what drops where.

## Features

- **Item Database:** every known Forever item, searchable by name or zone, filtered by level, quality, slot, class,
  source, zone, and dungeon or raid.
- **What changed:** one click shows what changed from Classic, better in green, worse in red.
- **Compare with your gear:** hold Shift over an item, or hover its Compare button, to see it beside what you wear.
- **Where it drops:** bosses, mobs, vendors, quests and containers, with map pins.
- **Favorites on your map:** star the items you want and they show on your World Map, at the spot or the dungeon
  where they drop.
- **Map counts:** how many items each zone and dungeon holds (Settings > Places on the Map).
- **Live Feed:** new and changed items you and other players find, newest first, with where each one dropped.
- **Pop-ups:** a card when a new find comes in, filtered the way you choose.
- **Found bar:** how many of the new items players have found so far.
- **Sharing:** finds go to other players on your ruleset, your guild and your group by themselves, under your
  character's name or anonymously.

## Use

`/fif` opens the window. So does the minimap button. Alt+click an item in your bags or in a chat link to open it in
the Item Database.

## Credits

Drop and location data comes from:

- QuestieDB, the quest database of Questie (GPL v3): https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB
- The CMaNGOS Classic database (GPL v3): https://github.com/cmangos/classic-db

# Forever Item Finder changelog

## 1.3.13

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: rogue poisons show their latest hotfix, Totem of the Storm is now Totem of the Maelstrom, and where to get 44 more new items.

### Bug Fixes
- **Test gear**: level-1 test copies of old items, like Super Hogger's Sulfuras, no longer show up as finds.

## 1.3.12

### Improvements
- **Open channel first**: if the sharing channel gets locked, the finder joins an open one right away.

## 1.3.11

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 5 hidden items now have names (Portable Wormhole Generator, Portable Repair Bot, Enchanted Silk Bag, Adventurer's Supply Bundle and Adventurer's Field Kit), Gnome Engineer's Renewal Gift shows what Forever changed, Small Brown-wrapped Package shows its latest hotfix, Destiny shows its drops in Blackmaw Hold, where to get about 250 more items, and about 160 fewer Not Found tags.

### Bug Fixes
- **Password pop-ups**: if someone locks the finder's sharing channel with a password, the finder no longer shows the game's password box on every try. It moves to a backup channel and leaves the locked one alone for a day.

## 1.3.10

### Improvements
- **Found for every known item**: an item's Found line now reads "Yes" whenever the item has a known way to get it (a drop, a quest, a vendor, a recipe), and "Yes, dungeon loot" for dungeon drops, instead of "Not yet in Forever" until a player shared it. Loot from raids Forever has not opened yet still reads "Not yet in Forever".
- **Fewer Not Found tags**: about 300 more new items now count as found, so the Not Found tag and chip show only the items nobody knows a way to get yet.
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: Forever's new epic armor sets (Grovekeeper, Justice, Glory, Spiritcaller and more) now show item level 60, Hardened Stone Band and Huntsman's Harpoon show what Forever changed, Bronze Mace, Whiteout Staff and Crackling Staff show their latest hotfix, 1 newly found item (Camper's Lure), and where to get 62 more new items (recipes, plans and patterns among them).

## 1.3.9

### Improvements
- **Smoother first look**: opening the Item Database and your first search no longer hitch. The finder prepares its counts quietly a little after you log in, and searches spread their work over more frames on slower computers.
- **Forever's new dungeons**: 159 items from The Drowned City, Alcaz Prison, Shaper's Terrace, Krol'dok Stronghold and Blackmaw Hold now name their boss and dungeon, show the entrance on the map, and appear under the Dungeon filter.
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 3 hidden items now have names (Shadow Scalper, Ancient Giant's Gaze and Cannibal's Cleaver), 12 old items show new changes from Forever (Totem of Rebirth is now Totem of Tides; Blade of Necromancy, Onyxia Blood Talisman and four Darkmoon Cards among them), and new drop places found by players.

## 1.3.8

### Improvements
- **Smoother Item Database**: clicking from item to item no longer costs frames, a search waits until you stop typing, and a new search or filter fills the list over a few frames behind a short loading screen instead of freezing the game.
- **Every vendor**: an item's page now lists every vendor that sells it, your own faction's first and the ones in your zone on top. The other faction's vendors come last and say so.
- **Every source**: an item's page now lists every quest that rewards it, every vein and herb that holds it, and every bag or box it comes out of, not just the first few.
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 15 hidden items now have names (Wit's Edge, Shaper's Robe and the Scarlet Hearthstone among them), 36 more old items show what Forever changed (Quel'Serrar, Shroud of Domination and Lord Valthalak's Staff of Command among them), 1 newly found item, and new drop places found by players.

### Bug Fixes
- **Set bonuses**: an item's page now fills in its set bonus text once the game sends it, instead of leaving "(3) Set:" empty.

## 1.3.7

### New Features
- **Compare with your gear**: hold Shift over an item in the finder to compare it with what you're wearing, or hover the new Compare button on an item's page. Settings, Items can switch it to Alt, Ctrl, always or off.
- **Auction prices**: the finder's item tooltips now show the prices your auction add-on has scanned.

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 17 hidden items now have names, 117 more old items show what Forever changed (Upper Blackrock Spire, Scholomance, Stratholme and Dire Maul gear and the Chromatic set among them), 2 newly found items, and drop places for about 1,900 more items.

## 1.3.6

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 70 hidden items now have names, 300 more old items show what Forever changed (Dire Maul, Stratholme, Scholomance and Blackrock Spire gear among them), 27 newly found items including mounts, companions and cosmetic sets, and new drop places found by players.
- **Mounts**: 67 mounts now show that Forever made them Bind on Pickup.
- **Quest rewards**: 66 items from new Forever quests now name the quest that gives them.

## 1.3.5

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 66 hidden items now have names, 89 more old items show what Forever changed (Scholomance, Stratholme, Blackrock Depths and Sunken Temple gear among them), and new drop places found by players.

## 1.3.4

### New Features
- **Minimap nodes**: within 50 yards of a marked vein, herb or chest, the minimap pin hides its icon and keeps its border, so you can see with Find Minerals or Find Herbs whether the node is up. Change the distance or turn it off under Settings, Favorites on the Map, Nodes.

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest hotfixes: 23 more new items, and 122 more old items show what Forever changed (Dire Maul, Sunken Temple, Maraudon and Blackrock Depths gear).

## 1.3.3

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest hotfixes: 34 hidden items now have names (new Dustwallow Marsh and Un'Goro quest rewards among them), 20 more old items show what Forever changed (Maraudon, Blackrock Depths and Blackrock Spire gear), and new drop places found by players.

## 1.3.2

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated to the latest Forever build: over 130 old items show what Forever changed (Zul'Farrak, Sunken Temple, Maraudon and Blackrock Depths gear), 61 hidden items now have names, and new drop places found by players.

## 1.3.1

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated to the latest Forever build: 78 hidden items now have names, 25 old items show what Forever changed (Maraudon gear among them), and new drop places found by players.

## 1.3.0

### New Features
- **Quest rewards**: rewards in your quest log are recorded without hovering them, and quest rewards shared by other players now name their quest.
- **Item changes on tooltips**: hold Alt over an item to see what changed from Classic right on its tooltip; Settings can switch it to Ctrl, Shift, always or off.

### Improvements
- **Dungeon finds**: items found inside a dungeon now show the dungeon's entrance on the map, including finds shared by other players.
- **How to get**: items without drop info yet now say what the player who found them saw, like the mob that dropped it or the dungeon it came from.
- **Item data**: 19 hidden items now have names, 12 old items show what Forever changed, and new drop places found by players.

## 1.2.5

### Bug Fixes
- **Item sharing**: finds from players who catch you up when you log in are no longer ignored.

## 1.2.4

### Bug Fixes
- **Display**: fixed some display issues.

## 1.2.3

# Forever Item Finder changelog

## 1.3.9

### Improvements
- **Smoother first look**: opening the Item Database and your first search no longer hitch. The finder prepares its counts quietly a little after you log in, and searches spread their work over more frames on slower computers.
- **Forever's new dungeons**: 159 items from The Drowned City, Alcaz Prison, Shaper's Terrace, Krol'dok Stronghold and Blackmaw Hold now name their boss and dungeon, show the entrance on the map, and appear under the Dungeon filter.
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 3 hidden items now have names (Shadow Scalper, Ancient Giant's Gaze and Cannibal's Cleaver), 12 old items show new changes from Forever (Totem of Rebirth is now Totem of Tides; Blade of Necromancy, Onyxia Blood Talisman and four Darkmoon Cards among them), and new drop places found by players.

## 1.3.8

### Improvements
- **Smoother Item Database**: clicking from item to item no longer costs frames, a search waits until you stop typing, and a new search or filter fills the list over a few frames behind a short loading screen instead of freezing the game.
- **Every vendor**: an item's page now lists every vendor that sells it, your own faction's first and the ones in your zone on top. The other faction's vendors come last and say so.
- **Every source**: an item's page now lists every quest that rewards it, every vein and herb that holds it, and every bag or box it comes out of, not just the first few.
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 15 hidden items now have names (Wit's Edge, Shaper's Robe and the Scarlet Hearthstone among them), 36 more old items show what Forever changed (Quel'Serrar, Shroud of Domination and Lord Valthalak's Staff of Command among them), 1 newly found item, and new drop places found by players.

### Bug Fixes
- **Set bonuses**: an item's page now fills in its set bonus text once the game sends it, instead of leaving "(3) Set:" empty.

- **Compare with your gear**: hold Shift over an item in the finder to compare it with what you're wearing, or hover the new Compare button on an item's page. Settings, Items can switch it to Alt, Ctrl, always or off.

### Improvements
- **Item data**: updated with Forever's latest data: 17 hidden items now have names, 117 more old items show what Forever changed (Upper Blackrock Spire, Scholomance, Stratholme and Dire Maul gear and the Chromatic set among them), 2 newly found items, and drop places for about 1,900 more items.
